summary: COLUMBUS MCKINNON filed an 8-K to announce a regular quarterly dividend of $0.07 per share, payable August 17, 2026, to shareholders of record August 7, 2026. This is a routine capital allocation action, not a special situation. The filing is an informational update with a press release attached. No other events were disclosed. The registrant is the issuer. Therefore, this filing does not qualify as a special situation.
